I went dark on Instagram this spring...and I felt it.

We didn’t post for nearly two months. :grimacing: I was deep in the weeds, training new team members and onboarding new clients. It was a season of growth behind the scenes, but our own marketing took a backseat.

When the dust finally settled, the impact was obvious:

→ Organic reach? Basically nonexistent.

→ Leads? Slowww.

→ Visibility? Barely there.

And honestly, I was tired of putting out good content that no one was seeing.

So I did what I’ve helped dozens of wedding pros do:

I turned on ads.

In August, we finally turned the spotlight on ourselves.

We launched our own Meta Ads with a modest budget, and in just a few weeks:

:sparkles: 121 new followers

:sparkles: 75 inquiries

:sparkles: 13 booked calls

It’s proof of what we already knew. Ads work when they’re done right.

(And with results like these, it's my guilt-free excuse to take Wednesday mornings off to watch new episodes of TSITP :two_hearts:)

So if you’ve been putting off your own marketing because client work always comes first (trust me, I get it), let this be your sign: running strategic ads doesn’t have to be overwhelming, and it can completely shift how clients find you.

Here’s to a new season of visibility, growth, and dream bookings.
